# termux-aichain (v0.1.0)
> Sovereign Zero-Dependency AI Chaining and Agent Framework for Termux & Android Edge

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-aichain
- Installation: `pip install termux-aichain
# or for Node.js:
npm install @termux-ai/chain`
- Architecture: Engineered under the Zero-Heavy-Dependency doctrine: Pure Python stdlib and pure Node.js ESM orchestration for local llama-server, BitNet 1-bit models, state graphs, and native Termux hardware APIs.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
from termux_aichain import (
    BitNetChat,
    create_react_agent,
    get_default_device_tools,
    Tracer,
    HumanMessage
)

# 1. Connect to local 1-bit or GGUF LLM
llm = BitNetChat(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8088/v1", model="bitnet-b1.58-3b")

# 2. Compile ReAct Agent with native Android device tools
agent = create_react_agent(model=llm, tools=get_default_device_tools())

# 3. Profile execution with local CLI tracer
tracer = Tracer("EdgeMobileRun")
with tracer.trace("AgentExecution"):
    result = agent.invoke({"messages": [HumanMessage(content="Check battery and sensor status.")]})

tracer.finish()
tracer.print_tree()
print("Agent Output:", result["messages"][-1].content)

```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
